title: Magnetic Properties of Dysprosium Cubanes Dictated by the M-O-M Angles of the [Dy4(μ3-OH)4] Core

synthesis.procedure: An aqueous KOH solution (0.45 mL, 0.20 mmol) was added to the Schiff-base ligand HL (0.20 mmol, 56 mg) in 10 mL of acetonitrile and stirred for 40 min. Solid DyCl3·6H2O (0.20 mmol, 75 mg) was then added and the red solution was stirred for 1 h. Methanol (5 mL) was added, the mixture was filtered, and the filtrate was left for slow evaporation. Red single crystals formed after 2 weeks, were collected by filtration, washed with cold methanol and acetonitrile, and dried in air.
synthesis.time: ligand/base stirred 40 min; after Dy addition stirred 1 h; crystals after 2 weeks
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate left unperturbed for slow solvent evaporation; red crystals collected after 2 weeks, washed with cold methanol and acetonitrile, dried in air

properties.summary: Dc susceptibility of cubane 1 (data normalized per Dy4) shows χMT = 53.6 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, decreasing to 23.1 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Magnetization at 2 K and 70 kOe reaches 24.4 μB without saturation; M vs H/T curves do not superimpose. No out-of-phase ac signal is observed under zero dc field, so 1 does not show slow magnetization relaxation, unlike related cubane 2.

synthesis.procedure: A methanolic KOH solution (0.35 mL, 0.15 mmol) was added to HL (0.15 mmol, 42 mg) dissolved in 6 mL of ethanol and stirred for 40 min. Solid Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.15 mmol, 68 mg) was added and the red solution was stirred for 1 h. Dichloromethane (6 mL) was added, the mixture was filtered, and the filtrate was left for slow evaporation. Red single crystals formed after 3 weeks, were collected by filtration, washed with cold ethanol, and dried in air.
synthesis.time: ligand/base stirred 40 min; after Dy addition stirred 1 h; crystals after 3 weeks
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: filtered; filtrate left unperturbed for slow solvent evaporation; red crystals collected after 3 weeks, washed with cold ethanol, dried in air

properties.summary: Octanuclear bis-cubane 2 (magnetic data normalized per Dy4) has χMT = 50.2 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, falling to 23.8 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K. Magnetization reaches 22.2 μB at 2 K and 70 kOe without saturation; M vs H/T plots do not superimpose. Frequency-dependent in-phase and out-of-phase ac signals under zero dc field (3.0 Oe ac field) indicate the onset of slow magnetization relaxation above 1.9 K, although no hysteresis is seen in M vs H on a conventional SQUID, consistent with relatively fast zero-field relaxation.
